title: Gherkin specs for standup reports (both profiles + shared stack)
description: Behavior specs first: standup report generation for Meeting script and Director brief profiles on the shared LiteLLM/right-now stack. Dual-runtime parity; SD reviews specs before implementation.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
SD review amendments pushed to PR #245: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/245

Changes:
1. Omit-IDs default scope = kanbus now (in_progress, cap 30, virtual_projects); director-brief board-wide without IDs
2. Observable signal rules for Yesterday/Today and Health/Momentum/Risks (standup.lookback_hours)
3. Likely questions contract from blocker summaries + stale WIP identifiers
4. Fixed JSON scenario (source_issues includes id; removed contradictory stdout check)
5. Cross-profile JSON parity on source_issues set + right_now_texts fields
6. virtual_projects congregation scenario in shared stack
7. Fixture models aligned to gpt-5.6-luna

Ready for SD re-review. Still @wip / spec-only.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
SD round-3 amendment pushed to PR #245: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/245

Standup omit-IDs default widened to in_progress OR blocked (congregation, cap 30, updated_at desc). Documented deliberate widening vs kanbus now in_progress-only; equivalence is kanbus now --status in_progress,blocked.

Added scenarios: blocked in fact feed + Blockers (meeting-script and director-brief); open/backlog excluded; proof standup includes blocked that plain kanbus now omits.

Ready for SD quick re-review.
